Bright cyan regions are distinct; light text on them needs a contrast measurement. Device-unavailable/headless-deterministic messages belong to the capture harness, so this image cannot diagnose native device failure. UI-20.

The warning remains visible, but contradictory readiness and idle progress hierarchy remain. Derive labels and action enablement from the same real prerequisites. UI-23.
